name: The Salt Ledger
premise: The sea returns the names of the dead on salt tablets. Tern burns them to keep its storm barrier lit; inland families demand their ancestors back.

locations.name: Ledger Hall
locations.description: Ledgers swell in their bindings. Magistrate Orr keeps a map of the barrier under a sheet of cracked glass.

locations.name: Flood Market
locations.description: Stallholders lift their wares above the tide line. A woman sells salt she insists came from no grave.

locations.name: Old Quay
locations.description: The quay stones bear names scratched out by desperate hands. A collector waits beside a broken cart.

locations.name: Breakwater Engine
locations.description: Behind three sealed doors, the storm engine consumes names in a blue and windless flame.

locations.name: Reed Ferry
locations.description: Neri poles a flat-bottomed boat through reeds hung with the families' mourning ribbons.

locations.name: Salt Orchard
locations.description: White crystals fruit on drowned trees. City collectors have stacked tablets under a canvas awning.

locations.name: Silt Shrine
locations.description: Someone has set empty bowls around a shrine to passengers lost between the banks.

locations.name: Drowned Archive
locations.description: Water laps at shelves of preserved testimony. The oldest account describes what happens to a name in the engine.

locations.name: Switchback
locations.description: An exposed road winds between quarry scars. Wind hums through abandoned conductor wires.

locations.name: Bell Foundry
locations.description: Workers have banked the furnaces. Above them the great wind bell turns without making a sound.

locations.name: Miners' Rest
locations.description: Sable tends the injured in a bunkhouse. The ward register still lists workers the city has written off.

locations.name: Wind Cairn
locations.description: Stone vanes crown the ridge. A damaged vent could redirect their power to the foundry.

locations.name: Pilgrim Gate
locations.description: Pilgrims leave their shoes at a gate made from tablet fragments, each inscribed with a promise.

locations.name: Ossuary Steps
locations.description: Steps descend into a salt-cut hollow. Pell recognises a warrant nailed above a collector's cache.

locations.name: Empty Basilica
locations.description: A single bell hangs above pews worn smooth by generations of waiting families.

locations.name: Storm Mouth
locations.description: The Cantor stands at the edge of a roaring white chasm, holding the final seal in both hands.

quests.title: A Name on the Tide
quests.brief: Orr asks Iona to recover a tablet shipment from the quay.
quests.completion: Resolve the quay confrontation and report to Orr.
quests.reward: Licence and access to the frontier roads.

quests.title: The Ferry's Due
quests.brief: Decide whether the names seized at the orchard go to their families or to Tern.
quests.completion: Confront the collectors; the manifest can open a negotiated settlement.
quests.reward: Fen seal; family allies at the engine or a reinforced city barrier.

quests.title: The Bell and the Burden
quests.brief: The foundry strike has stopped extraction and endangered the barrier.
quests.completion: Resolve the foundry dispute. A repaired vent makes worker control negotiable.
quests.reward: Ridge seal; worker-controlled conductors or civic control.

quests.title: The Keeper's Claim
quests.brief: The Cantor will not surrender the seal without proof or a trial.
quests.completion: Show the archive testimony or defeat the Cantor.
quests.reward: Scar seal; the Cantor remembers how the party answered.

quests.title: The Last Account
quests.brief: With three seals, approach the engine and decide whose names will fuel the future.
quests.completion: Overcome the custodian and choose the barrier, return, or eligible covenant.
quests.reward: A final scene and an account of regional and companion consequences.

quests.title: A Passenger List
quests.brief: Neri's ferry manifest was hidden when the collectors arrived.
quests.completion: Recover the manifest and show it to Neri.
quests.reward: Evidence for a negotiated Fen settlement.

quests.title: A Breath for the Bell
quests.brief: The foundry's wind conductor leaks through a damaged vent.
quests.completion: Repair the vent or divert its remaining flow to the city.
quests.reward: Worker leverage or a stronger civic supply.

quests.title: The Stolen Name
quests.brief: A market trader possesses a tablet that belongs to a pilgrim family.
quests.completion: Return the tablet to the family or register it with Orr.
quests.reward: A family's gratitude or civic credit.

quests.title: The False Assay
quests.brief: A shipment's assay declares ancestral salt to be ordinary mineral.
quests.completion: Compare the orchard records and expose or suppress the false assay.
quests.reward: Evidence against the collectors or a payment from the trader.

quests.title: The Empty Bowl
quests.brief: Neri wants to learn who was aboard the last ferry lost in the fog.
quests.completion: Find the manifest and bring the passenger's story to the shrine.
quests.reward: Neri's passenger remembered and a protective charm.

quests.title: Warrant of Collection
quests.brief: Pell signed a warrant under orders and wants the family to see the truth.
quests.completion: Recover the warrant and decide whether to expose Pell's signature.
quests.reward: Evidence of the collection order and Pell's amended bow.

quests.title: The Abandoned Ward
quests.brief: Sable's patients were left behind when the foundry closed.
quests.completion: Recover the ward register and secure help for the patients.
quests.reward: Sable's medical kit and the workers' trust.

endings.title: Keep the Barrier
endings.text: Tern keeps burning the names. The storm wall holds while the families outside the city mourn a second time.

endings.title: Return the Names
endings.text: The names go home. The city evacuates beneath a failing wall, carrying its living into an uncertain inland future.

endings.title: Shared Covenant
endings.text: With the archive's testimony and worker-controlled wind conductors, city and families agree to share the burden instead of burning the dead.
